sections.beforeHtml: The toolbar is the horizontal control bar at the top of Plantour. It is the main way to move between the main Plantour functions, open grouped commands, and keep track of the currently selected trip.
items: Click the Plantour logo to return to the start route.
Click "Dashboard" to open the dashboard directly.
After signing in, the "Dictionary" button opens a pop-up menu with dictionary-related commands. Click the button to open the menu, then click a menu item to close the menu and navigate there.

After signing in, the "Trip" button opens a pop-up menu with commands related to trips and the currently selected trip. Click the button to open the menu, then click a menu item to close the menu and navigate there.

Trip commands that depend on a current trip work only after a trip is selected. Some of them are also unavailable when you are not included in the selected trip, so the toolbar does not send you to commands you cannot use.

The sandwich button with the "bars" icon opens an additional pop-up menu. It contains general commands such as profile, help, contact, public templates, legal information, and sign-in or sign-out depending on your current account state.
When you are signed in, the sandwich menu also contains "Show Trip" or "Hide Trip". This control switches the current trip name line under the toolbar on or off.
If the current trip name line is visible, clicking the trip name opens the trips list so you can change the selected trip.
